recorded.rule: Q2 v2: a giveaway, read from the question's own text alone
recorded.prompt:q-cancel-running: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.
recorded.pass:q-cancel-running: an independent page-free reader (25-fork-join q2), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-cancel-running: from the question's text alone, the reader picked 'a'; the key is 'b'
recorded.because:q-cancel-running: others carry absolute terms ('no effect at all'; 'only cancel(false)') and share one another's opening; a alone repeats the stem's 'true'
